terms.gloss: given over to drugs, addicted to drugs
evidence: M-O s.v. obsessed, addicted: (alicui reī) īnsānē dēditus
terms.comment: A description: dēditus with the dative, “devoted, given over to”, is classical (dēdō, Lewis & Short), and Morgan–Owens builds addiction on it; the drug is Traupman’s term. Traupman has no word for an addict.

evidence: M-O s.v. drug addict, after Egger
terms.comment: A modern coinage from Greek; addiction is toxicomania (M-O). Classical toxicum is a poison.

sources: Lewis & Short: dedo · Lewis & Short: toxicum
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 307.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. drug addict; obsessed, addicted.
